text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAHHHH~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The puppet――! The puppet isss, aaaaaagh!!
It just ate a whole human being~~~~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: What do we do, Flight!? At this rate, the protagonist is gonna get eaten too!!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: You're right... We need to get away, quickly...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait—whaaaat, I'm cornered?!
What do I do, what do I do, Chitose Oooo?!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: Ho ho ho ho...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaat?!
Why are you laughinggg?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, *sniff*, uwaaah... I'm so glad
I managed to knock down the target doll, waaaah~~~~...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... That chase scene
was truly terrifying, though...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, it's true!! The doll's arm suddenly went
zooom and reached right out! Right, Chitose O!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho ho... Yes,
that was quite amusing...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! You're still not surprised...?!
Chitose O... you're way too incredibleee~!!
While walking through the central plaza, I spotted Sakura Chitose O and the others chatting away cheerfully.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Wouldn't you be scared
if a doll's arms suddenly went *whizzz*!?

After asking, it turned out that
the three of them had watched a horror movie together.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
――But you know, Chitose O is never,
ever startled by anything!! Isn't that incredible?!

From what Winning Ticket says, the movie sounds terrifying.
And yet, Sakura Chitose O remains completely unfazed...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho ho...
For all things follow their natural course...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Rain falls, leaves drop, and ripples stir the water's surfaceâ
Once something begins, it inevitably moves toward its end...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
The beginning of things, and the end... As long as
I know those, my heart will remain undisturbed...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
In other words—
Huh? What does that mean?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If one understands cause and effect,
there is nothing to be surprised by—would that be it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Indeed, once the doll turned aggressive, it was only to be expected that it would attack.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho ho... Even the rampage of wicked things
will eventually subside... 'Tis the way of the world...

What she's saying makes complete sense, but――
I can't help but be amazed that she can remain this composed.
choice_data_list: I wonder what would actually surprise you, then.
You're calmer than I am, that's amazing...
You're so much calmer than me, it's amazing...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If that doll showed up right here――
would they actually freak out, I wonder!!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
That too is rather amusing...
Ho ho ho ho...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
To dread calamity is...
only natural, after all—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
That too... is very like a child of man,
and a fine thing indeed... Ho ho ho...
